notes: Unlocks fire from real Game travel/observe/collect/ArchiveDex/Lifeling/campaign paths. LAUNCH_CAMPAIGN_COMPLETION is finite and is not GLOBAL_SPECIES_KNOWLEDGE_BASE_COVERAGE. No test-only unlock type exists. No grind-all-species achievement.

achievements.title: First Discovery
achievements.description: Complete your first ethical wildlife observation.

achievements.title: Region Hopper
achievements.description: Visit three explore regions beyond the museum hub.

achievements.title: Era Walker
achievements.description: View two distinct Time Atlas eras or periods.

achievements.title: Provenanced Record
achievements.description: File a notebook entry that carries source, license, and citation.

achievements.title: Taxonomic Breadth
achievements.description: Document species from two different taxonomic groups.

achievements.title: Lifeling Growth
achievements.description: Grow your Lifeling (level 2 or first affinity module).

achievements.title: Companion Style
achievements.description: Customize your Lifeling name, color, or equipped trait.

achievements.title: Scientific Curiosity
achievements.description: Record a documented group with source-aware field notes.

achievements.title: Launch Campaign Complete
achievements.description: Finish the finite launch campaign (not global species coverage).

achievements.title: Pause and Breathe
achievements.description: Pause a live expedition and resume it.

achievements.title: Archive Credits
achievements.description: Open credits after acknowledging the launch finale.
